data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 桥上的停步
data.description: 木桥下的水流声让蕾娜停下脚步。她倚着栏杆往下看，等水面的一片落叶漂过桥洞。
data.action: leaning on a bridge railing and watching a leaf in the water
data.promptProse: Leaning over the rustic wooden railing of a mossy arched bridge, Lena watches a single scarlet maple leaf float lazily along the clear mountain stream below. Sunlight pierces through a canopy of vibrant red and gold autumn trees, casting dancing reflections across the rippling water and illuminating her serene, contemplative profile.
